svg.title: How I build
svg.desc: A terminal types each step, then a short reply follows. Spot the boring problem. Give the model the right context. Teach it to use tools. Try to break it. Measure what actually improved. Ship it. Watch it. Make it better.

g.text: The boring one is usually the real job.
Give the model the right context
The whole folder just makes it guess.
Let it look things up, not invent answers.
If I can fool it, a user will too.
A nicer demo is not a better answer.
It counts once someone else can use it.
Weird cases show up after it leaves my laptop.
Then I fix the part that actually failed.
